# GPU device list from profiles/h100.yaml in the nvml-mock Helm chart, chart
# version 0.3.0.
#
# This records an EXTERNAL fact: how many GPUs the chart's h100 profile
# provisions per node. setup-gpu-sim_test.sh checks GPUS_PER_WORKER against
# this file rather than against itself, so the constant is pinned to what the
# chart actually does and the suite stays hermetic (no registry pull).
#
# The chart_version and chart_digest lines below are asserted equal to
# NVML_MOCK_CHART_VERSION and NVML_MOCK_CHART_DIGEST, so bumping the chart pin
# fails the suite until this file is regenerated. The digest matters as much as
# the version: the 0.3.0 TAG was re-pushed upstream to a different chart layer
# while still calling itself 0.3.0, so a version line alone would have gone on
# agreeing across the move.
#
#   helm pull oci://ghcr.io/nvidia/k8s-test-infra/chart/nvml-mock@<new-digest> \
#     --untar --untardir /tmp/nvml-chart
#   grep -E '^  - index:' /tmp/nvml-chart/nvml-mock/profiles/h100.yaml
#
# The device lines below are that grep's verbatim output.
chart_version: 0.3.0
chart_digest: sha256:637b4a534b9b91d231cd179cf91374aed7e4bbcda648fbd597ad858e269365c6
profile: h100
devices:
  - index: 0
  - index: 1
  - index: 2
  - index: 3
  - index: 4
  - index: 5
  - index: 6
  - index: 7
